sentences.en: He tried to convince her, but his efforts were in vain.
sentences.zh: 他试图说服她，但他的努力徒然无功。

sentences.en: No amount of studying will help if you don't pay attention; it's all in vain.
sentences.zh: 如果不专心听讲，再怎么学习都是徒劳无益的。

sentences.en: She called out for help, but her cries were in vain as no one heard her.
sentences.zh: 她大声呼救，但她的叫声徒然无人听见。
